name: Self-Employment Residency (Individual Establishment / SPC)

requirements.blocker_text: Registration of a 100%-foreign-owned Individual Establishment (sole proprietorship) or Single Person Company (SPC) with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) via the Invest Easy portal, with no local sponsor required.
requirements.fix_path: Register an Individual Establishment or SPC via Invest Easy.

requirements.blocker_text: A Ministry of Labour work permit application on the basis of the self-owned entity, plus a Royal Oman Police entry/residence permit, medical exam, and biometric registration.

evidence_required.document: MOCIIP business registration (Individual Establishment or SPC)

sources.title: Jobbers -- Oman freelance/self-employment pathway: sponsor-free 100%-foreign-owned Individual Establishment or Single Person Company via Invest Easy/MOCIIP, Ministry of Labour work permit, ROP residence permit, ~OMR 4,300 total setup cost, 2-year residence validity
